changelog:
v5.0.1 — Channel surfing fix

• Fixed: changing channels with Up/Down or CH+/CH- sometimes showed the new channel's name and guide info while the picture stayed on the channel you started from. This happened when you switched onto a channel with surround sound. The picture now always follows the channel you picked.

• Switching between several surround-sound channels in a row is smoother, with less of a pause on each change.

Includes everything from v5.0: Catch Up, the redesigned movie pages, and the live channel recovery improvements.
